# Claims ledger

A1, the membership half. The policy declares a relevance scale and this entry uses a value outside
it. Constraining membership is all the validation does: the scale is a set, not an order, and no
detector may infer that one member is worth more than another. An ordering would smuggle the
epistemic ladder back in through the axis introduced to keep it out.
